# forumulate_space (Resource)

A space: one docs site, forum, blog, changelog, status page and so on. The `type` decides its tabs, its piece names, its layouts and which other resources apply to it (see the `forumulate_space_types` data source). Creating a space and then managing its theme, SEO, redirects and settings is `forumulate_space` plus `forumulate_space_settings`.

Destroying a space moves it to the trash (readers and the API stop seeing it; the platform can restore it). Set `destroy_on_delete = true` to make it permanent and free the slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_space" "docs" {
  slug       = "docs"
  name       = "Docs"
  type       = "DOCS"
  visibility = "PUBLIC"

  translations_json = jsonencode({
    es = { name = "Documentación", description = "Guías y referencia" }
  })

  settings_json = jsonencode({
    trashRetentionDays = 30
  })
}

resource "forumulate_space" "community" {
  slug       = "community"
  name       = "Community"
  type       = "FORUM"
  visibility = "PUBLIC"
}

# A space type that has no opinion of its own is shaped at creation.
resource "forumulate_space" "recipes" {
  slug = "recipes"
  name = "Recipes"
  type = "CUSTOM"
  shape = {
    index       = "list"
    order       = "chronological"
    nav         = "tags"
    who_creates = "members"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The space's name, 1 to 120 characters.
- `slug` (String) The space's address segment (2 to 48 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). Cannot change; changing it replaces the space.
- `type` (String) The space type. One of `DOCS`, `FORUM`, `BLOG`, `ROADMAP`, `CHANGELOG`, `STATUS`, `LEGAL`, `FAQ`, `CAREERS`, `CONTACT`, `EVENTS`, `COURSES`, `CUSTOM`, `CONTENT`, `ABOUT`. Cannot change; changing it replaces the space. `GET /space-types` describes each.

### Optional

- `destroy_on_delete` (Boolean) On destroy, permanently delete the space after trashing it (all its content, files and domains), which frees the slug for reuse. Defaults to `false`: the space stays in the trash, restorable.
- `external_ref` (String) Your own reference for this space (printable ASCII, up to 200 characters), fixed at creation: repeating a create with the same reference answers the existing space.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Tags an orchestrator keeps on the space: keys of letters, digits and `_.:-` (up to 64 characters), values up to 500 characters. Replaced whole on change. The API does not return them on a read, so drift is not detected.
- `preset` (String) The named layout the reader wears, validated against the type (`GET /space-types/{type}/presets`). Create-time only: change it later with `forumulate_space_settings`.
- `seed` (Boolean) Whether to create the starter structure this type ships with. Left unset a token-created space gets none. Create-time only.
- `settings_json` (String) Space settings, merged into the stored ones at the top level: each key replaces that key whole and a key you remove from the configuration is cleared. A setting that has its own door (`theme`, `seo`, `redirects`, a layout) belongs to `forumulate_space_settings` and is refused here by name. A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.
- `shape` (Attributes) How a `CUSTOM` space works: its index, order, navigation and who may create pieces. Create-time only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shape))
- `site_id` (String) A site (by id) the new public space joins. Create-time only; membership afterwards is `forumulate_site.space_ids`.
- `translations_json` (String) The space's name and description in other languages: `{ "es": { "name": "Documentación", "seoTitle": "..." } }` per language code. Replaced whole on change. A JSON document: write it with `jsonencode()`. Drift is detected only for the keys you declare, so settings someone else manages are left alone.
- `visibility` (String) `PUBLIC` or `PRIVATE`. Defaults to `PRIVATE`. Some types are always private (the API says so on apply).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the space was created.
- `id` (String) The space's id (a UUID).

<a id="nestedatt--shape"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shape`

Optional:

- `index` (String) `landing`, `list`, `board` or `single`.
- `nav` (String) `tree`, `categories`, `tags`, `sections` or `none`.
- `order` (String) `manual`, `chronological`, `activity`, `votes` or `status`.
- `who_creates` (String) `staff`, `members` or `anyone`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# By the space's slug (or its id).
terraform import forumulate_space.docs docs
```
